AgentSam is an independent project of Inner Animal Media.

AgentSam is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or partnered with Cloudflare, Inc., or with any other company whose products or services are named in this repository.

Cloudflare is a registered trademark of Cloudflare, Inc. Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2, Vectorize, Durable Objects, Cloudflare Images, Cloudflare Stream, Cloudflare Containers, and Wrangler are names of Cloudflare products and services.

Other product, service, and company names mentioned in this repository, including Google, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Supabase, Vercel, HubSpot, Canva, Meshy, FreeCAD, OpenSCAD, Tauri, Cursor, Resend, Stripe, and Blender, are trademarks or service marks of their respective owners. They are used only to identify the products and services that AgentSam can work with. Their use does not indicate affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship.

## Naming

Packages, commands, skills, and presets in this repository are intended to describe what they do rather than borrow another company's brand. Names of integration targets (adapter ids, CLI subcommands, environment variable names) appear where needed to describe what the software connects to.

## Using AgentSam in your own projects

AgentSam may flag common trademark and copyright patterns in a project, for example third-party marks in names, recreated third-party logos, or material without a recorded source. Results are informational. They are not legal advice and are not a determination that anything is or is not infringing, licensed, or approved. You are responsible for the names, marks, images, fonts, text, and code in your own projects and for the licenses and terms that apply to them.
